@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb._note: The DynamoDB chat stores import the low-level command classes from here; the consumer injects the client (a DynamoDBClient, or a DynamoDBDocumentClient from @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb, which wraps one).

@tiptap/y-tiptap._note: Loaded lazily by ./client/useCanvasDocument (require-on-use), so importing ./client does NOT need it installed — only calling canvasToDocModel / materialize does. ./adapters/tiptap needs it outright.

pptxgenjs._note: Required only by ./deck renderPptx (.pptx generation); the model, validator, constraints and SVG preview work without it.

react._note: ./client/ws re-exports GatewaySocketProvider, which is a React component — the subpath is Yjs-free, not React-free.
